deadline.value: Fall 2027 applications open in October 2026 and close June 30, 2027 (11:59 pm PT); apply earlier to be considered for entrance scholarships.

also.quote: Fall 2027: Accepting applications for Fall 2027 start: October 1, 2026 - June 30, 2027

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: You must secure a supervisor before applying and confirm this in the application.
supervisor.quote: Applicants should secure a supervisor prior to applying to the program. | applicants will be required to confirm that they have secured a supervisor prior to applying

funding.value: PhD students get guaranteed minimum funding of CAD 30,000 a year for 12 terms, subject to progress.
funding.quote: Students in the program will be funded for a minimum of 12 terms. | Students in the PhD program will receive guaranteed minimum funding in the amount of $30,000

entry_route.value: A bachelor's plus an MSc in environmental science or a related discipline is required.
entry_route.quote: Completion of a Bachelor of Science degree (or equivalent) and a Master of Science in Environmental Sciences or a related discipline

notes: PhD applicants upload two writing samples.
